game.title: Borderlands 3
game.blurb: Co-op looter shooter with RPG growth, from Gearbox Software (RAWG also lists 2K), released 2019-09-13. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Fifteen hidden achievements from the base game, mostly story milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Missions and Challenges
chapters.summary: Side missions, the Circles of Slaughter, the Eridian Proving Grounds, Hammerlock's hunts, Zer0's targets, Eridian Slabs, named locations and the Firing Range.

chapters.title: Levels, Gear and Combat
chapters.summary: Levelling to 50, gear, skins and vehicle parts, combat feats, loyalty packages and unlocking every achievement.

chapters.title: Co-op and Social
chapters.summary: Duels, reviving another player, sending items to friends, tipping Moxxi and the slot machine.

chapters.title: Add-on Set: Achievements 46 to 52
chapters.summary: The "All Bets Off" mission, Ember's statues, the Mayor's outfit, Mr. Torgue's hot sauces, blackjack, the Clapstructor and the wandering Debt Collector.

chapters.title: Add-on Set: Xylourgos (53 to 60)
chapters.summary: Finding the party, marrying your friends, the Wendigo, Xylourgos crew challenges and ECHO logs, rare spawns and fish jokes.

chapters.title: Add-on Set: Hidden (61 to 75)
chapters.summary: Fifteen hidden achievements numbered 61 to 75 in the Steam list. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Add-on Set: Arms Race and Stormblind (76 to 81)
chapters.summary: Arms Race rounds and gear, the Stormblind Complex, Ava's podcast mysteries, Hemovorous and the Eridium piles.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 397540)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Borderlands_3
Fandom (borderlands.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://borderlands.fandom.com/wiki/Borderlands_3
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls the app "Oak" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 397540. 31 of 81 Steam achievements are hidden. Achievements 46 onwards look like later add-ons, but the data does not name them, so the add-on chapters are grouped by Steam API number and described with the places and tasks their descriptions name; which add-on each set belongs to was not checked. "Good One, Babe" (hidden, number 56) was put with the 53 to 60 set by number only. Achievements 61 to 75 are all hidden, so their set has no description. "Exoarchaeolo—You Get The Gist" (number 19) is hidden and sits with the base-game story. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub); only its "Table of Contents" subpage exists (about 250 characters), and Walkthrough, Controls and Gameplay are linked but not created, so nothing was used. borderlands.fandom.com answers the API, with about 148 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
